sentences.text: 2. The above case is charge sheeted alleging offence punishable under Section 498A IPC.

It is submitted that the entire dispute between the petitioner and the victim are settled out of court and the victim filed an affidavit as evident by Annexure - A6.
3.
This Court perused Annexure-A6.
Since it is a matrimonial offence, I think the continuation of the prosecution against the petitioner is not necessary in the light of the settlement.
Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C. No.861/2018 on the file of the Judicial First Class Maisgtrate Court - II, Kannur arising from Crime No.3/2004 of Valapattanam Police Station are quashed.
